_what: THE OFFER - one file, every brief's beat 7 reads from it. Change it here, push, and every brief shows the new offer within a minute. No brief file gets touched.
_why: Founder, 23 Sep 2026: 'traditionally if I want to change the offer I need to go into every single HTML and apply the changes. Rather, I want the HTMLs wired up to something central.'

_beat_7_has_THREE_parts.1_lead_in: HERS. Lives in her own brief file, not here. The sentence that walks her persona from beat 6 into the offer - Georgia's is 'if you gave up years ago, you've been going without for no reason'. Written once when the brief is written. An offer change does NOT rewrite it.
_beat_7_has_THREE_parts.2_urgency: SHARED, below. Why today rather than later. It lives here and not in the brief because it MOVES WITH THE OFFER - 'they're selling out' is wrong once the offer becomes free shipping.
_beat_7_has_THREE_parts.3_offer: SHARED, below. The facts. Never reworded per brief - '$29.95' should not be phrased 34 different ways.

_how_to_change_it: Open edit-offer.html in this folder, or edit this file directly.
Replace offer.json, then: push the offer.
GitHub Pages rebuilds in about a minute. Every brief is current.
